explanation: Delivery now reads one data-origin layout (src/data/dataOriginLayout.ts) for pointer keys, build-id rules, generation prefixes, cache policy, purge prefixes and WAF admission, and one query-generation reader (scripts/lib/queryGeneration.mts) behind prepare:deploy, fetch:query and the uploader. The uploader publishes only WAF-admitted keys and reports others. delivery.md, EDGE_PROTECTION.md and the catalog sources describe this; Cloudflare payloads are byte-identical.
